ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic map of the distribution areas and occurrence frequency of sandstorms in China. The legend uses background colors of different depths to indicate the number of sandstorm occurrences; dark colors indicate more occurrences, and light colors indicate fewer occurrences. On the map, in the northwest region, especially the northern Xinjiang area, a darker high-frequency distribution area can be seen; near the Horqin Sandy Land in the northeast is not the most prominent dark high-frequency center. Then reason: The question stem asks for “the first region called a sandstorm center of China in the incorrect statement.” This incorrect statement corresponds to “the Junggar Basin and the Horqin Sandy Land are sandstorm centers of China,” in which the first region is the Junggar Basin.

method.method_draft: 先读图：观察中国地图中沙尘暴出现次数的图例，深色表示出现次数较多，浅色表示较少；再在图中定位新疆北部的准噶尔盆地和东北部的科尔沁沙地。准噶尔盆地附近可见高频深色区，而科尔沁沙地所在的东北部并不是图上最突出的高频中心。再读题干：问题问“不正确说法中被称为我国沙尘暴中心的第一个地区”。因此应对应到那个错误表述“准噶尔盆地和科尔沁沙地为我国沙尘暴中心”，取其中第一个地区，答“准噶尔盆地”。
